caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a bottle-shaped container made to resemble a small barrel. The container is rendered in light and dark brown tones that indicate a wood grain texture, with several horizontal wooden staves bound together by darker hoops, giving it the appearance of a coopered vessel. The bottle has a narrow neck and widens towards the shoulders and body, tapering slightly towards the base. At the top is a cylindrical, light beige stopper or cork. Around the bottom edge is a metallic-looking band, depicted in gray, suggesting reinforcement. The object is centered on a plain, off-white background with no other elements or objects present.
title: Wooden Wine Bottle
